```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml:2052`, `ci.yml:2172`, `ci.yml:2193`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

Non-blocking: the warn-and-continue fallback keeps this safe, so this can land in a follow-up rather than holding the PR.

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

## Acceptance

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag
- [ ] pre-flight guard + docs landed

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

## Acceptance

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash

  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag
- [ ] pre-flight guard + docs landed

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash

code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

## Acceptance

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag
- [ ] pre-flight guard + docs landed

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

## Acceptance

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag
- [ ] pre-flight guard + docs landed

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

## Acceptance

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag
- [ ] pre-flight guard + docs landed

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

blocks.text:
# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev

  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \

```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag
- [ ] pre-flight guard + docs landed

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash

code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \

  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

## Acceptance

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag
- [ ] pre-flight guard + docs landed

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash

Two consequences:

## PR Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

## Acceptance

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag
- [ ] pre-flight guard + docs landed

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

## Acceptance

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag
- [ ] pre-flight guard + docs landed

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# gh-1511: [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

## Symptom

`publish-fa-llm.yml` red since 2026-08-14 (runs 31769138784, 31769199332, both on tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`). The `publish` job dies at upload:

```
Validating package...
Uploading...
Message from server: Only users are allowed to upload new packages.
```

## Root cause (known pub.dev restriction)

pub.dev **automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an existing package** — the very first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human user. `fa_llm` does not exist on pub.dev yet, so the OIDC flow is refused with exactly this message.

## Fix (two steps)

1. **Owner, one-time**: `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` from a logged-in user account (per repo convention: manual publish allowed on explicit owner instruction for the first publish). After the package exists, add the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`).
2. Then re-tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0` (or bump to v0.1.1) and the workflow goes green.

## Never-again

- The workflow should pre-flight this exact condition and print the actionable message instead of a bare exit 1: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` — 404 ⇒ "first publish must be manual, see issue #1511" and exit with a distinct code.
- Document the first-publish dance in the package README / release checklist (AGENTS.md pub.dev section covers the core package only).

## Acceptance

- [ ] fa_llm v0.1.x live on pub.dev
- [ ] publish-fa-llm.yml green on the next tag
- [ ] pre-flight guard + docs landed

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

## General PR Comments

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):

💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the

  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic

  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.

  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher

  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.

  GitHub Release (`fa-<os>-<arch>[.exe]`); `installer-smoke` verifies
  installers.

  secrets: `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID/_ISSUER_ID/_KEY_CONTENT`,
  `MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64/_PASSWORD/MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID`,

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the
  GitHub Release (`fa-<os>-<arch>[.exe]`); `installer-smoke` verifies
  installers.
- App builds (`build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, manual dispatch):
  Android AAB + iOS IPA on `[self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]`, macOS DMG/ZIP
  signed + notarized, TestFlight via `flutter_app/fastlane`. Optional
  secrets: `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID/_ISSUER_ID/_KEY_CONTENT`,

  (issue #544: build 160, boot refactor created the platform env before

  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.

  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new

  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher

  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the

  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic

  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the

  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit

  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the
  GitHub Release (`fa-<os>-<arch>[.exe]`); `installer-smoke` verifies
  installers.
- App builds (`build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, manual dispatch):
  Android AAB + iOS IPA on `[self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]`, macOS DMG/ZIP
  signed + notarized, TestFlight via `flutter_app/fastlane`. Optional
  secrets: `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID/_ISSUER_ID/_KEY_CONTENT`,

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the
  GitHub Release (`fa-<os>-<arch>[.exe]`); `installer-smoke` verifies
  installers.
- App builds (`build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, manual dispatch):
  Android AAB + iOS IPA on `[self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]`, macOS DMG/ZIP
  signed + notarized, TestFlight via `flutter_app/fastlane`. Optional
  secrets: `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID/_ISSUER_ID/_KEY_CONTENT`,
  `MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64/_PASSWORD/MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID`,

  crash before the first frame white-screens TestFlight with a green gate
  (issue #544: build 160, boot refactor created the platform env before
  `WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized`); boot stage order is pinned by
  `flutter_app/test/boot/app_boot_test.dart`.

  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic

  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the

  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit

  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the
  GitHub Release (`fa-<os>-<arch>[.exe]`); `installer-smoke` verifies
  installers.

  Android AAB + iOS IPA on `[self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]`, macOS DMG/ZIP
  signed + notarized, TestFlight via `flutter_app/fastlane`. Optional
  secrets: `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID/_ISSUER_ID/_KEY_CONTENT`,

  crash before the first frame white-screens TestFlight with a green gate
  (issue #544: build 160, boot refactor created the platform env before
  `WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized`); boot stage order is pinned by

  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the

  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic

  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the
  GitHub Release (`fa-<os>-<arch>[.exe]`); `installer-smoke` verifies
  installers.
- App builds (`build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, manual dispatch):
  Android AAB + iOS IPA on `[self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]`, macOS DMG/ZIP
  signed + notarized, TestFlight via `flutter_app/fastlane`. Optional
  secrets: `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID/_ISSUER_ID/_KEY_CONTENT`,
  `MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64/_PASSWORD/MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID`,

  crash before the first frame white-screens TestFlight with a green gate
  (issue #544: build 160, boot refactor created the platform env before
  `WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized`); boot stage order is pinned by
  `flutter_app/test/boot/app_boot_test.dart`.

  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic

  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release

  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic

  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.

  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First

  Android AAB + iOS IPA on `[self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]`, macOS DMG/ZIP

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the
  GitHub Release (`fa-<os>-<arch>[.exe]`); `installer-smoke` verifies
  installers.
- App builds (`build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, manual dispatch):
  Android AAB + iOS IPA on `[self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]`, macOS DMG/ZIP
  signed + notarized, TestFlight via `flutter_app/fastlane`. Optional
  secrets: `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID/_ISSUER_ID/_KEY_CONTENT`,
  `MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64/_PASSWORD/MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID`,
  `GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64`. Both workflows hard-gate the binary
